test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If interest is being compound annually, then what sum will amount to Rs. 9464 in 2 years at the rate of 30 percent per annum at compound interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount (A) = Rs. 9464

Rate (R) = 30%

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = P(1 + Rate/100)Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ 9464 = P(1 + 30/100)²

⇒ 9464 = P(1 + 0.30)²

⇒ 9464 = P(1.30)²

⇒ 9464 = P × 1.69

⇒ P = 9464 / 1.69

⇒ P = 5600

**∴ The principal sum is Rs. 5600.**
